interpretation: This is a failure of the current sufficient abstract bound. It is not an asserted reachable CNF, not a runtime OPEN witness, and not a counterexample to the N<=57 theorem.
diagnosis: The old raw bound separately maximized retained-clause width mass and distinct-resolvent width mass, allowing both groups to reuse the same widest signed-clause slots. The engine raw container is a single deduplicated set, so a global distinct signed-clause-universe bound can be strictly stronger.
